subject: content-research-grounding

subject: image-prompt-composition
a: one compiled prompt string shipped verbatim to a caption-class generator and to a brief-reading multimodal generator; the adapters differ only in negative delivery
b: one style contract, two renderings - a front-loaded tag list for the caption class, a purpose-first brief with closed cardinality for the multimodal class
read_from: scratchpad/exp-a-7/dialect.mts: under A both targets receive the identical prompt body (delta 265 bytes, all of it negative delivery) and neither states a purpose first nor closes cardinality; under B the two bodies differ and the brief target gains both. What the harness cannot read is whether the pixels improve.
instrument: pipeline/build-style-trials.mts re-run dialect-matched - the repo's own 6-style x 5-beat grid, 60 graded cells per policy, scored usable = on-brief AND free of text. The existing 60-cell trial that demoted the caption-class provider ran one dialect's prompt across both classes, so it is the same instrument with the confound removed.
note: The compiler's own header states the caption-class constraint it was written for ('CLIP-conditioned models see roughly the first 77 tokens'), which is the dialect assumption travelling to a model that does not hold it.
